description: PLANNED adapter — OpenHands is NOT installed and NOT wired into the harness. This descriptor is a design-only sketch of how an OpenHands worker WOULD present the same interface: sandboxed edit-and-run inside its own worktree and lease, local commit, and branch handoff for the Terminal-0 sheriff to review. OpenHands can drive a broader tool surface, so its forbidden_tools list is deliberately strict. Nothing here installs, launches, sandboxes, or authorizes OpenHands; a future admission would still require its own contract proof and the standard founder gates.

input_contract.mission: PLANNED: a single scoped mission would be delivered as the OpenHands agent task.
lease_globs: PLANNED: the lane's file-lease glob(s), enforced by the harness outside the worker
input_contract.branch: PLANNED: a harness-assigned foundergate/<slug> branch; no branch switching.
hard_exclusions: no application runtime activation or marker flip
no arbitrary shell egress or container escape

artifacts: PLANNED: files inside the assigned lease only
expected_outputs.commit_message_convention: PLANNED: a proof(...) subject with the required Co-Authored-By trailer

pr_handoff.body_convention: PLANNED: harness-standard PR-body trailer; a GATE REPORT block when a true founder gate appears.

integration_evidence: PLANNED / NOT-INSTALLED: OpenHands is not present in this environment and has no live harness wiring.
PLANNED: this descriptor is a design-only sketch; admitting OpenHands requires its own contract proof + strict sandbox review + founder gates before status could ever become 'real'.
